summary: Clean on MEM. This is a pure-Python helper (no @njit/@cfunc, no NRT refcounts, no struct-by-value ABI). The only memory-relevant surface is the lifetime of the ctypes buffer behind the yielded pointer, and that is handled correctly: the create_string_buffer is held by the suspended @contextmanager generator frame for the duration of the with block and freed on exit, exactly as documented. The interior-NUL guard correctly prevents silent C-string truncation. No findings.
